messages:
sam: Heads-up: SCIM provisioning to tenant 'nebula-corp' started returning 401s ~09:22 UTC. SAML SSO logins unaffected.
anika: Pastes from scim-provisioner logs (redacted):
```
2026-03-22T09:21:58Z WARN scim-provisioner oauth: token request failed: 401 - {"error":"invalid_client","error_description":"Client authentication failed"}
2026-03-22T09:22:00Z ERROR scim-provisioner user-sync: createUser failed: unauthorized
```
security-bot: Alert: OIDC client credential rotation job completed for client=scim-provisioner-nebula at 09:15:12 UTC (rotation-run-id=rot-20260322-09-15).
tim: if the IdP rotates client secrets it invalidates refresh tokens / sessions sometimes. did infra update the k8s secret / env var for the deployment?
anika: checked k8s secret; it shows new secret value and timestamp 09:16:03, but the pod env shows old hash (restart not triggered). ops-bot: deployment/scim-provisioner lastRestart=2026-03-21T01:10:02Z.
olivia: That would explain it: provisioner is still using an in-memory refresh token or cached client assertion; when client secret is rotated upstream, the old refresh token is revoked and token exchange fails with invalid_client.
sam: immediate mitigation?
tim: quick fix: restart scim-provisioner pods so they load the updated secret and re-run auth flow. Longer fix: add an RBAC-safe webhook to trigger restarts when rotation job updates secrets, or implement secret reload without restart.
anika: restarting pods now (kubectl rollout restart deploy/scim-provisioner -n infra).
ops-bot: rollout restart initiated at 09:24:30 UTC.
anika: pods back up at 09:26:11; running a few test provisions against nebula-corp.
sam: test provisioning succeeded for 3/3 users. backlog clearing.
security-bot: IdP audit: POST /token for client_id=scim-provisioner-nebula returned 401 (invalid_client) from 09:21:56 to 09:24:20; after rotation, client secret in use was not recognized until deployment restarted.
olivia: action items:
- create incident ticket SEC-2026-017 (sec + infra) documenting rotation->restart gap
- add a pre-rotation canary that hits token endpoint using current client creds and verifies refresh success
- infra: add automation to patch deployments (rolling restart) whenever secret manager writes a new secret to k8s (opt-in per service)
- dev: implement graceful secret reload for scim-provisioner (supports client-secret hot reload)
tim: also check RBAC mapping: during the outage a couple of requests returned 403 after auth succeeded — looked like a mapping change on the IdP (role_claim renamed to roles_v2) earlier this week. let's run a smoke of role->app-role mapping for a sample tenant.
security-bot: Noted: schedule RBAC mapping audit for next week.
sam: filing postmortem draft. I'll include timeline + detection + mitigation + follow-ups. tagging @oncall for 24h watch. :eyes:
anika: Incident created: SEC-2026-017 (internal link). closing thread once smoke passes for other tenants.
